tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun mchog zab yang dag gi: sgrub chen lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs:

ྈྈྈ he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: phun sum tshogs pas gzhi bzung la: sgrub pa tshom bu 'tshogs pa'i nang: pho mo lha dang grangs sprad de: sngon 'gro'i rim pa gzhung bzhin bya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni: hūm̐: 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing: gdug pa srid gsum 'dul ba dang: nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir: he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bsgom: hūm̐: chos rnams skye med spros dang bral: 'gag med ye shes kun tu khyab: stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pa'i: rang rig hūm̐ sngon 'bar bar gyur: rdo rje rgyu yi he ru ka: thugs nas ye shes yaṃ ra suṃ: keṃ raṃ bhrūm̐ 'phros nam mkha'i klong: 'thor rlung khrag mtsho zhing gi sa: keng rus ri rab me chen 'bar: dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus: 'khor lo thod pa'i gzhal yas khang: dregs pa byol song zhing gis brgyan: lha chen mgo dang tsitta'i tog: dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus: phyi nang rim gnyis me phung 'khrugs: khrag zhag 'bab cing 'jigs su rung: gru chad 'khor lo'i dbus rtsibs na: padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ru dra dri za gshin rje srin: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol gdan la: byol song khyu mchog ma he dang: gzig dang stag ni zung gi khri: rgyu yi khrag 'thung dbus su 'khod: dbu dang phyag mtshan bsam yas pa: khro mo dbyings phyug ma dang rol: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa badzra kro dha dzwa la maṇḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ha la ha la hūm̐: byang chub sems kyi khro bo'i tshogs: mkha' khyab spros nas dregs pa btul: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka hūm̐: badzra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka hūm̐: buddha kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka hūm̐: ratna kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐: oṃ padma shrī he ru ka hūm̐: oṃ padma kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐:

oṃ karma shrī he ru ka hūm̐: karma kro dhī shā rī hūm̐: bdag nyid yang dag he ru ka: mthing nag dkar dmar sngo ba'i zhal: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas: dril bu dung dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: gar dgu'i nyams ldan zhabs bzhi rol: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: kro dhī shwa rī nam mkha'i mdangs: kha ṭwāṃ dung dmar 'dzin pa 'khril: 'bar ba'i phreng ba rab tu 'khrugs: shar du buddha he ru ka: smug nag g.yas dkar g.yon mthing zhal: tir dbyug rdo rje khyung chen g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: kro dhī shwa rī dung dmar stob: lho ru ratna he ru ka: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser zhal: rin chen tir dbyug dgra st+wa g.yas: 'jig rten dung dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: kro dhī shwa rī dung dmar stob: nub tu padma he ru ka: dmar nag g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal: padma be con dgra st+wa g.yas: 'jig rten dung dmar rgyu zhags g.yon: kro dhī shwa rī dung dmar stob: byang du karma he ru ka: ljang nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal: rgya gram ral gri dgra st+wa g.yas: 'jig rten bhandha thong gshol g.yon: kro dhī shwa rī dung dmar stob: zhabs bzhi byol song gdan la rol: kun kyang sbyor ba'i byang sems las: ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha: oṃ badzra gau rī ha: oṃ badzra tsau rī ha: oṃ badzra pra mo ha ha: oṃ badzra bai tā li ha: oṃ badzra pukka si ha: oṃ badzra ghasma rī ha: oṃ badzra sme sha ni ha: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa lī ha: rtsibs kha gru chad rnam brgyad la: gau rī chos nyid mi 'gyur sngo: ye shes dbyings su sgrol ba'i dbyug: tsau rī ye shes rgyas pas ser: thugs rje bskul phyir mda' gzhu 'geng: pra mo thugs rjes chags pas dmar: nyon mongs rgyu mkhyen chu srin 'dzin: be tā chos nyid mi 'gyur nag: sa dgur spor ba'i rdo rje 'dzin: pukka ma 'gags dmar ser 'bar: 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod byis rgyu 'dren:

ghasma las bzhi thogs med ljang: nyon mongs dbyings sgrol thod khrag dkrug: sme sha thabs shes mi 'gyur mthing: nyon stong khams sku'i bam snying gsol: tsaṇḍa lhun grub skyon bral ser: mtha' gnyis zhing gi mgo lus phral: he he he he he he he he: oṃ badzra siṃ ha mu kha he: oṃ badzra byā ghṛ mu kha he: oṃ badzra shṝ ga mu kha he: oṃ badzra shwa na mu kha he: oṃ badzra ghṛ ḍha mu kha he: oṃ badzra kaṃ ka mu kha he: oṃ badzra khwa kha mu kha he: oṃ badzra ū lu mu kha he: 'bar ba'i gser khyams chen po ru: siṃ ha kha ro bsnol ser seng: byā ghṛ mnan stabs bsnol ma stag: shṝ ga nag mo byis ldag wa: shwa na 'dral lta mthing ga spyang: ghṛ ḍha mgrin dmar rgyu 'dren rgod: kaṅka zhing phrag snar mgo ring: khwa kha kha ro bhan gri nag: ū lu lcags kyu mthing tshogs 'ug: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: oṃ badzra ārya te dza te nga dza: oṃ badzra a mu khe hūm̐: oṃ badzra lo ka baṃ: oṃ badzra bhasmi pā la ya ba tu ho: pho brang nang ma'i sgo bzhi la: rta gdong sngon mo lcags kyu 'dzin: phag gdong nag mo mche zhags can: seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom: spyang gdong ljang nag dril bu dgyes: kun kyang khro mo dur khrod chas: zhing rlon gdan la gar gyis rol: 'khor ba'i 'dzin lus phyir thon te: hūm̐ ho: zhes bskul kun sbyor sems sprin las: rtog sgrib sbyangs nas 'od du zhu: gser zhun lta bu'i thig ler gyur: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs: yi ge gsum ni hūm̐ du 'dus: zla ba la gnas rlung gis bskyod: lha tshogs bskor nas gtso bo yi: thugs kar thim nas yab yum rol: sku yi dbyibs brgyud yum mkhar gnas: bde ba chen po'i rkyen gyis ni: gtso 'khor ma lus 'od du zhu: 'od kyi phung po gcig tu gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐: yi ge phyag mtshan lha ru gyur: spyi bor rigs lnga yab yum sbyor: chu yis sgrib sbyangs dbang bskur nas:

yab yum rigs lngas dbu yang brgyan: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: ā darsha= sa ma tā= pra ti bekṣa ṇa= kṛ tyānuṣṭha na= gnas lngar zla ba padma dang: nyi ma rin chen rgya gram la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod: ye shes lnga rnams bsdus nas thim: rigs lnga yab yum sku ru gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: wā ka= tsitta= a nu rā ga ṇa= pū dza= yab gsang hūm̐ las rdo rje'i dbus: oṃ dkar bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag: yum mkha' paṃ las padma'i sbubs: aṃ dmar ge sar es mtshan gyur: sa ma ya st+waṃ: sa ma ya ho: a nu rā ga haṃ: a nu rā ga yā mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sbyor ba'i byang chub sems sprin gyis: rgyal ba kun bkug bde bas zhu: sku yi dbyibs brgyud gsang bar babs: yum gyi mkha' la lan gsum spros: yan lag bzhi yi tshul du rdzogs: rten dang sa bon bcas par gyur: hūm̐ ha he phaṭa: khrag 'thung dbyings phyug khro mo dang: phra men sgo ma bcas su gyur: phaṭa dza: rim bzhin phyir phyung mdun mkhar bzhugs: spro bsdus sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsgrubs: spha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: kun kyang rang rang gdan la 'khod: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: ma nu raksha sī bhyo: brahma ṇī bhyo: rau trī bhyo: baiṣṇa bī bhyo: ku mā rī bhyo: ind+ra nī bhyo: badzra siṅga laṃ bhyo: a mṛtaṃ bhyo: sau mya bhyo: daṇḍa daṃ bhyo: rakṣa sī bhyo: bakṣa sī bhyo: rā ti badzra bhyo: ru dhi ra martā bhyo: e ka tsa ri ṇī bhyo: ma no ha raṃ bhyo: siddhi kaṃ bhyo: bā ya bī bhyo: ma hā mā ra ṇa bhyo: agnī bhyo: bā rā hī bhyo: tsa muṇḍi bhyo: su ta nāṃ bhyo: bā ru ṇī bhyo:

badzra ma hā kā li bhyo: badzra tsa ka lā bhyo: badzra kumbha karṇā bhyo: badzra lambo dha ra bhyo: thugs nas bhyo yig nyer brgyad 'phros: khrag khyams 'bar dang phyi sgo ru: srin mo smug nag thod rlon 'chang: tshangs pa dmar ser padma bsnams: lha chen dkar ljang tri shū la: rtog 'dod sngon mo 'khor lo 'chang: gzhon nu dmar mo mdung thung 'dzin: brgya byin dkar mo ind+ra gdengs: rdo rje ser mo tsan dan 'thung: bdud rtsi dmar mo padma bsnams: zla ba dkar mo puṇḍa rī: be con ljang nag dbyug pa phyar: srin mo dmar mo dung khrag 'thung: za ba ljang nag ba su 'dren: dga' ba dmar mo rke dar phyar: stobs chen dkar mo gshol mda' 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo spu gris gcod: 'dod pa dmar mo mda' gzhu 'geng: nor srung dkar mo bum pa 'dzin: rlung lha sngon mo ba dan phyar: gsod byed dkar mo ral gri 'dzin: me mo dmar mo gsal shing phyar: phag gdong nag mo mche zhags can: rgan byed dmar mo zhing chung za: sna chen dkar ljang thod khrag 'thung: chu lha sngon mo sbrul zhags 'dzin: rdo rje nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: rdo rje ser mo ra mgo zhags: rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog sdom: rdo rje ljang nag dril 'khrol dgyes: zhing lpags gos gsol thod rgyan can: zhing rkyang keng rus gdan la rol: kun kyang rigs kyi dbu rgyan dang: ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa: drag po rtse gsum rnams kyis mtshan: ngo bo ro gcig ma 'dres pa: dkyil 'khor bsam yas lhun grub gyur: bzlas pa'i rim pa shes pa brgyad: dkyil 'khor oṃ ni sku lnga dang: ru lu sems dpa' phyi ma yum: hūm̐ ni sgo ba bhyo sgo ma: hūm̐ ni thub pa drug tu shes: oṃ ni gtso bo yab yum bcu: ru lu gong 'og gnas yul ma: hūm̐ bhyo sgo ma dbang phyug ma: oṃ hūm̐ dbyer med lha yang de: oṃ ni ye shes ru lha drug: mnyam nyid ngang du shes pas mchod: phrin las 'phro 'du don gnyis byed:

zhi rgyas dbang drag sgrub pa che: dbyangs ni zab cing drag ngar khol: dbugs 'byin mdzo mo bu stor bzhin: bud med skad ltar phra dkyus ring: mi gsal bung ba rdzas 'khor bzhin: sgra ni oṃ ni ye shes lnga: ru gnyis chags pa yum gyi mkha': hūm̐ ni dgyes pa bhyo chos dbyings: hūm̐ yang ye shes lnga dang ldan: bsnyen pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan: chos nyid chos dbyings las 'phros thim: de ltar dgongs pa brgyad dang ldan: dngos grub ma lus 'dis 'grub byed: de ltar zab pa'i mthar thug 'di: nam mkha'i snying po'i snying la gdams: ma 'ongs don du gter du sbos: skal ldan mchog dang 'phrad nas kyang: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par shog: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya:
